scope: Election-scoped source-column party codes for the 2019 official segment sheets; original native headers retained. No cross-election candidate identity or party merger inferred.
punctuationNote: JD(U), JDU (United) and (United)(JD(U)) are source-header punctuation/name renderings of the same explicitly named party in selected sheets; retained as JD(U). No merger, alliance or defection alias is applied. Other source codes remain literal, including RJSP.
